the 2-mercaptodihydropyridines and the 2-alkylthiodihydropyri midines are not acetylated in the 1-positions of the ring, but are acetylated in their 3-positions.
the acetyl derivatives are not the 1,3,4-trisubstituted pyrimidine compounds but are the 2,4,5-trisubstitu-ted compounds, the 1-acyl and 3-acyl isomers.

the reaction of 6-aryl and 6-alkenyl compounds proceeds through the intermediate of the 1-acetyl derivative, while the reaction of 5,6-disubstituted compounds proceeds through the 3-acetyl intermediate.

acetylation of 1,3-diketones and the corresponding 1,2-diketones is not stereospecific, but the acetyl group enters the molecule preferentially in the 1-position.
the acetyl group can be placed in the pyrimidine nucleus in two positions, and that the acetyl derivatives are more soluble and more readily crystallized than the parent compounds.
